question: What triggers a Probe Response from all 802.11 networks in the area? [IEEE 802.11]
options: A Probe Response frame from a network with a given name
A Beacon frame transmitted by an access point
A Beacon frame transmitted by a station in the BSS
A Probe Request frame with a broadcast SSID
correct_answer: A Probe Request frame with a broadcast SSID

question: What is a mesh gate?
options: A basic service set (BSS) that forms a self-contained network of mesh stations (STAs) that use the same mesh profile.
The set of all neighbor mesh stations (STAs) of a particular mesh STA.
A concatenated set of mesh links from a source mesh station (STA) to a destination mesh STA.
Any entity that has a mesh station (STA) function and a distribution system access function (DSAF) to provide access to a single distribution system for the mesh basic service set (MBSS).
A link from one mesh station (STA) to a neighbor mesh STA that have a mesh peering with each other.
correct_answer: Any entity that has a mesh station (STA) function and a distribution system access function (DSAF) to provide access to a single distribution system for the mesh basic service set (MBSS).
